output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'balances[msg.sender] >= _value && _value > 0' allows attackers to overflow balances, granting them more tokens than intended.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'balances[_from] >= _value && allowed[_from][msg.sender] >= _value && _value > 0' allows attackers to overflow balances, granting them more tokens than intended.

The 'receiveApproval' function has a wrong logic. The function is intended to be called by a 3rd party contract, but it does not check if the spender is a contract. This can be exploited to allow attackers to set allowance for any address.
